description: Official alternative outfit replaces the default Triss character slot.
conversion: Original outfit, boots and painted cloth freedom. Cloth rebased from the imported pose into the normalized skeleton. The unsupported opaque eye-shadow overlay is omitted; teeth and original eye surfaces remain.
lowerBody: The generic game female lower-leg/foot surface is skin-coloured for this bare-legged outfit; hidden overlapping native lower surfaces are excluded. This is not a claim that original DLC boots contain complete unique calves.
accessories: No commute bag or home slippers; shoes are removed by hand and the character stands without footwear.
